title: Relative clauses: who, which, that, whose, where
summary: Join short sentences into smooth, longer ones without losing the reader.

lesson.introEn: Relative clauses join two ideas into one sentence. Examiners love them because they show range, as long as you pick the right little word.
lesson.introVi: Mệnh đề quan hệ ghép hai ý thành một câu. Giám khảo rất thích vì chúng thể hiện sự đa dạng ngữ pháp, miễn là bạn chọn đúng "từ nối" nhỏ xíu.

sections.heading: Who for people, which for things, that for both
sections.bodyEn: Use who for people and which for things. In defining clauses, that can replace both.
sections.bodyVi: Who cho người, which cho vật. Trong mệnh đề xác định, that thay được cả hai.

examples.en: The teacher who helped me most was Ms Lan.
examples.vi: Giáo viên giúp tôi nhiều nhất là cô Lan.

examples.en: The phone that I bought last month is already broken.
examples.vi: Chiếc điện thoại tôi mua tháng trước đã hỏng rồi.

sections.heading: Commas or no commas?
sections.bodyEn: If the clause tells us which one, use no commas. If it only adds extra information, put it between commas and never use that.
sections.bodyVi: Nếu mệnh đề cho biết "cái nào" thì không có dấu phẩy. Nếu chỉ thêm thông tin phụ thì đặt giữa hai dấu phẩy, và không bao giờ dùng that.

examples.en: Students who skip breakfast find it hard to concentrate.
examples.vi: Học sinh bỏ bữa sáng thì khó tập trung.
examples.note: Which students? Those who skip breakfast.

examples.en: Hanoi, which is the capital, has terrible traffic.
examples.vi: Hà Nội, thủ đô, có giao thông rất tệ.
examples.note: Extra information: we already know which city.

sections.heading: Whose and where
sections.bodyEn: Whose shows that something belongs to someone. Where is for places, followed by a subject and a verb.
sections.bodyVi: Whose chỉ sự sở hữu. Where dùng cho nơi chốn, theo sau là chủ ngữ và động từ.

examples.en: I have a friend whose father is a pilot.
examples.vi: Tôi có một người bạn có bố là phi công.

examples.en: This is the café where we first met.
examples.vi: Đây là quán cà phê nơi chúng tôi gặp nhau lần đầu.

commonMistakes.wrong: The man which lives next door is a doctor.
commonMistakes.right: The man who lives next door is a doctor.
commonMistakes.whyVi: Người thì dùng who. Hàng xóm của bạn không phải đồ vật đâu!

commonMistakes.wrong: Hanoi, that is the capital, is very busy.
commonMistakes.right: Hanoi, which is the capital, is very busy.
commonMistakes.whyEn: That cannot be used in a clause between commas.
commonMistakes.whyVi: Mệnh đề nằm giữa hai dấu phẩy không dùng that.

commonMistakes.wrong: The city where I visited was beautiful.
commonMistakes.right: The city that I visited was beautiful.
commonMistakes.whyEn: Visit needs an object, so use that or which, not where.
commonMistakes.whyVi: Visit cần tân ngữ (visit somewhere), nên dùng that/which chứ không dùng where.

lesson.ieltsTipEn: In Writing Task 2, combine two short sentences with a relative clause to improve flow: "Many students work part-time. This affects their studies." becomes "Many students work part-time, which affects their studies."
lesson.ieltsTipVi: Trong Writing Task 2, hãy gộp hai câu ngắn bằng mệnh đề quan hệ để bài mượt hơn: "Many students work part-time. This affects their studies." thành "Many students work part-time, which affects their studies."

questions.prompt: The teacher ___ helped me most was Ms Lan.
questions.explanation: A teacher is a person, so use who.
questions.explanationVi: Giáo viên là người nên dùng who.

questions.prompt: This is the village ___ my grandparents grew up.
questions.explanation: A place, followed by a full clause (my grandparents grew up): where.
questions.explanationVi: Nơi chốn, theo sau là một mệnh đề đầy đủ (my grandparents grew up): dùng where.

questions.prompt: Children ___ parents read to them often enjoy books.
questions.explanation: The parents belong to the children: whose.
questions.explanationVi: Bố mẹ "của" các em nhỏ: dùng whose.

groups.instructions: Write who, which, whose or where.

questions.prompt: Smartphones, ___ were rare twenty years ago, are now everywhere.
questions.explanation: Extra information about things, between commas: which (never that).
questions.explanationVi: Thông tin phụ về đồ vật, nằm giữa hai dấu phẩy: which (không dùng that).

questions.prompt: Da Nang is a city ___ many tourists go for the beaches.
questions.explanation: A place, followed by a subject and verb (many tourists go): where.
questions.explanationVi: Nơi chốn, theo sau là chủ ngữ và động từ (many tourists go): where.

groups.instructions: Spot the mistake: tap the word that is wrong.

questions.prompt: The girl which won the prize is my cousin.
questions.correction: The girl who won the prize is my cousin.
questions.explanation: The girl is a person: who.
questions.explanationVi: Cô bé là người: dùng who.

questions.prompt: My laptop, that I bought last year, is already slow.
questions.correction: My laptop, which I bought last year, is already slow.
questions.explanation: Between commas, use which, not that.
questions.explanationVi: Giữa hai dấu phẩy thì dùng which, không dùng that.

groups.instructions: Join the sentences using the word in brackets.

questions.prompt: I have a friend. Her brother is a famous singer. (whose)
accepted: I have a friend whose brother is a famous singer.
questions.explanation: Her brother belongs to my friend, so whose replaces her.
questions.explanationVi: Anh trai là "của" người bạn, nên whose thay cho her.
